mapper.insert: INSERT INTO batch_import_record (file_name, total_count, success_count, fail_count, status, created_by) VALUES (#{fileName}, #{totalCount}, #{successCount}, #{failCount}, #{status}, #{createdBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE batch_import_record SET success_count = #{successCount}, fail_count = #{failCount}, status = #{status}, error_detail = #{errorDetail} WHERE id = #{id}
